body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> PowerLab presented ''PLT-919'', its19-inch monitor TV that supports any kind of signal reception in different regions. With its own TV-board, built-in speaker, and a remote control, it can serve as a sort of sub-TV. It features a contrast ratio of 1,500:1, brightness of 250cd/m2, and PAV Samsung panel.

Gi-soon Park, vice president of the company, said that by establishing its own TV development and manufacturing capacities in 2007, the company is going to get ready to respond various needs in different markets and it will continue to make products targeting niche market as well as household market.
The company is going to display other product lineup at the upcoming CES 2007 including monitor TV (17/19-inch) and LCD TV (32/40-inch).
